newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin price ends down three cents.
newsitem.headline: KL tin price ends down three cents.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell three cents to 14.67 ringgit ($5.84) a kg after sales outnumbered bids in the domestic market despite a higher close on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Monday.
The lower price also meant that the Kuala Lumpur Tin Market was at par with the LME, which closed $10 higher on Monday.
"There's no discount or premium," said a dealer.
Offers totalled 124 tonnes against bids of 86. Final turnover was at 106 tonnes, compared to 95 on Monday. Buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
